indicator.name: S&P 500 Forward P/E
indicator.description: The S&P 500 price divided by consensus next-twelve-month earnings.
indicator.methodology: S&P 500 index level divided by consensus expected earnings for the next twelve months. The earnings basis (operating or reported) is supplied with the imported series and shown in the source metadata.
indicator.limitations: No free, authorized historical forward-earnings series is bundled. The indicator stays unavailable until a licensed CSV or URL is configured. Trailing P/E is never substituted and relabeled as forward P/E.
